finalBackgroundPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: background layer for existing app screenshot showcases.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the current blue textured background.
Replace the entire background with a completely flat, uniform, solid light gray, exact color #F1F1F1 (RGB 241, 241, 241).
Preserve the same wide 16:10 canvas framing.
The result must contain only this plain light gray color. No gradient, no texture, no grain, no glow, no clouds, no atmospheric effects, no vignette, no lighting effects, no shadows, no words, no logo, no UI, no objects.
The screenshot and description will be composited separately; do not draw any of them.
background: #F1F1F1, uniform RGB 241, 241, 241; normalized to a flat solid fill
